read.thesis: Q3 production release shows strong Oyu Tolgoi and Pilbara volumes, copper flat YoY and copper guidance unchanged; supply growth is ramping (Simandou, Oyu Tolgoi) while the capital-release program adds a discipline angle.

capex.quote: Our major projects remain on schedule and budget, underwriting our growth profile to 2030.

triggers.label: Simandou ~10 Mtpa run-rate in Q3
triggers.quote: The Simandou iron ore mine hit an annualised production run-rate of ~10 Mtpa (100% basis) in the quarter

triggers.label: Yarwun alumina output cut 40% in Q4
triggers.quote: Yarwun production is expected to reduce by 40% in Q4 2026, as announced in November 2025, due to tailings constraints.

triggers.label: Lithium guidance at low end
triggers.quote: full year production expected at the low end of the guidance range, primarily reflecting the slower ramp-up at Sal de Vida.

triggers.label: Kennecott furnace breach cut Q3 cathode
triggers.quote: The outage drove lower cathode production in Q3.

guidance.quote: full year production expected at the low end of the guidance range
as part of the $5 to 10 billion capital release program

red_flags.label: Kennecott geotechnical and seismic issues
red_flags.quote: A seismic event occurred on 10 September. The mine plan sequence and potential impacts are being assessed

red_flags.label: Lithium Sal de Vida ramp slower than planned
red_flags.quote: ramp-up is progressing slower than anticipated due to available uptime of key equipment.
